Apple (AAPL) Holder Northstar Group Has Upped Position; Shire Plc (SHPG) Market Valuation Declined While Accipiter Capital Management Has Upped Stake
May 14, 2018 - By reb123z
Gabe Hoffman increased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 33.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Accipiter Capital Management Llc bought 12,738 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The hedge fund run by Gabe Hoffman held 50,243 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.79M, up from 37,505 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Accipiter Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $51.05B market cap company. The stock increased 2.26% or $3.76 during the last trading session, reaching $170.21. About 1.05M shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500.
Northstar Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 14.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northstar Group Inc bought 4,017 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 31,734 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.37M, up from 27,717 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northstar Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.70B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $188.54. About 12.26M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
